title: Seacrest Beach 44 Brenda Lane Main House
h1: Seacrest Beach 44 Brenda Lane Main House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Newly redecorated- Across the street from Gulf- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle (Starting March 1, 2022)- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $50 per day**- Multiple living areas- Professionally decorated- Grill- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Located just across the street from the beach! 44 Brenda Lane in Seacrest Beach is a beautiful 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom home with accommodations for 18 guests in the main house. It's notable features include a private pool, outdoor entertaining area, pool table, multiple living areas, and its prime location to the Gulf! It's also equipped with 4 adult bikes to make cruising to Rosemary Beach or around 30A a breeze. The first floor of the home welcomes guests with professionally decorated interiors and an informal living area. There is also a queen sleeper sofa, pool table, and flat-screen TV. There are 2 guest rooms on this floor that both feature comfortable king beds and private bathrooms, one of which has private access to the backyard. The main level of the home is on the second floor, where guests can find a grand, open kitchen and the main living area. The kitchen can seat a combined 20 guests at the formal dining table, kitchen island, and informal dining table without having to separate your group. It's completely stocked with premium appliances and tools that the chef may need to prepare meals. The spacious living area also has plenty of room to gather around and watch TV together. There are three guest rooms on this floor-the first has a king bed, while the next features a twin over full bunk with a twin trundle bed, the final has two queen beds and a twin-over-twin-over twin bunk bed with a twin trundle bed. There are 2 bathrooms that are shared between the bedrooms and the hallway. Guests will love having their own pool in the backyard that is completely fenced in for extra privacy! There is an outdoor fireplace with seating, meant to enjoy year-round. There is also a picnic-style table and grill for guests to use and make al fresco dinners enjoyable. Don't miss your chance to stay at 44 Brenda Lane and book with 360 Blue today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Room: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin over Full Bunk bed and Twin Trundle Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, One Twin over Twin Bunk Bed and Twin Trundle, Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.**Garage is not for guest use.
